name: verify-completion
description: Makes Claude prove work is done before saying so: a six-gate verification skill with coherence and depth audits, a read-only verifier agent scaled to the size of the change, an opt-in workflow that cross-checks every finding, and a Stop hook that sends Claude back for a checkable Verification record when a reply presents finished work without one. It never authorizes commits, pushes, or deploys.

enforcement.title: Completion-claim enforcement
enforcement.description: enforce: when a reply claims work is finished without a valid Verification record, Claude is asked once to verify, then you are warned. warn: only warn you. off: the hooks do nothing; the skill and agent stay available.
